question: 2026年6月华东地区销售订单总金额是多少？
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(oi.qty * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)), 2) AS total_amount FROM sales_order o JOIN order_item oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.region = '华东' AND o.order_date >= '2026-06-01' AND o.order_date < '2026-07-01'

question: 2026年6月各地区销售金额排名
gold_sql: SELECT o.region, ROUND(SUM(oi.qty * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)), 2) AS total_amount FROM sales_order o JOIN order_item oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.order_date >= '2026-06-01' AND o.order_date < '2026-07-01' GROUP BY o.region ORDER BY total_amount DESC

question: 销售额最高的前3个客户是谁？

question: 截至2026年7月1日仍未发货的订单有哪些？
gold_sql: SELECT o.order_id, o.customer_name, o.due_date FROM sales_order o WHERE o.status = 'pending' AND o.due_date < '2026-07-01' ORDER BY o.due_date

question: 库存低于安全库存的物料有哪些？
gold_sql: SELECT m.material_id, m.material_name, SUM(i.on_hand_qty - i.locked_qty) AS available_qty, m.safety_stock FROM material m JOIN inventory i ON i.material_id = m.material_id GROUP BY m.material_id, m.material_name, m.safety_stock HAVING SUM(i.on_hand_qty - i.locked_qty) < m.safety_stock ORDER BY (m.safety_stock - SUM(i.on_hand_qty - i.locked_qty)) DESC

question: 物料伺服电机的可用库存是多少？

question: 各供应商在途采购数量是多少？
gold_sql: SELECT po.supplier_name, SUM(po.qty) AS in_transit_qty FROM purchase_order po WHERE po.status = 'in_transit' GROUP BY po.supplier_name ORDER BY in_transit_qty DESC, po.supplier_name

question: 2026年6月计划完工的工单完工率
gold_sql: SELECT wo.wo_id, wo.planned_qty, wo.completed_qty, ROUND(wo.completed_qty * 1.0 / wo.planned_qty, 4) AS completion_rate FROM work_order wo WHERE wo.planned_end >= '2026-06-01' AND wo.planned_end < '2026-07-01' ORDER BY wo.wo_id

question: 整机设备的BOM所有子件及单台总用量是多少？
gold_sql: WITH RECURSIVE bom_tree(parent_id, child_id, total_qty, level) AS (SELECT b.parent_material_id, b.child_material_id, b.qty_per_parent, 1 FROM bom b WHERE b.parent_material_id = 'FG001' UNION ALL SELECT bt.child_id, b.child_material_id, bt.total_qty * b.qty_per_parent, bt.level + 1 FROM bom_tree bt JOIN bom b ON b.parent_material_id = bt.child_id) SELECT bt.child_id AS material_id, m.material_name, ROUND(SUM(bt.total_qty), 4) AS total_qty, MIN(bt.level) AS first_level FROM bom_tree bt JOIN material m ON m.material_id = bt.child_id GROUP BY bt.child_id, m.material_name ORDER BY first_level, bt.child_id

question: 按状态统计订单数量
gold_sql: SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM sales_order GROUP BY status ORDER BY order_count DESC

question: 各物料分类的库存金额是多少？

question: 2026年6月各物料分类的销售金额

question: 订单ORD-1012的物料齐套率是多少？
gold_sql: WITH RECURSIVE bt(root_id, parent_id, qty, level) AS (SELECT oi.material_id, oi.material_id, oi.qty, 0 FROM order_item oi WHERE oi.order_id = 'ORD-1012' UNION ALL SELECT bt.root_id, b.child_material_id, bt.qty * b.qty_per_parent, bt.level + 1 FROM bt JOIN bom b ON b.parent_material_id = bt.parent_id), req AS (SELECT material_id, SUM(qty) AS required_qty FROM (SELECT oi.material_id, oi.qty FROM order_item oi WHERE oi.order_id = 'ORD-1012' AND oi.material_id NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT parent_material_id FROM bom) UNION ALL SELECT bt.parent_id AS material_id, bt.qty FROM bt WHERE bt.level > 0) GROUP BY material_id), sup AS (SELECT m.material_id, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(i.on_hand_qty - i.locked_qty) FROM inventory i WHERE i.material_id = m.material_id), 0) + COALESCE((SELECT SUM(po.qty) FROM purchase_order po WHERE po.material_id = m.material_id AND po.status = 'in_transit'), 0) AS supply_qty FROM material m) SELECT r.material_id, m.material_name, r.required_qty, s.supply_qty, ROUND(MIN(1.0, s.supply_qty * 1.0 / r.required_qty), 4) AS fill_rate FROM req r JOIN material m ON m.material_id = r.material_id JOIN sup s ON s.material_id = r.material_id ORDER BY fill_rate ASC, r.material_id
